notes: Head correction only, for the cross-verse split described in the report: חֲסָדָיו -> *good deeds* was headed on the supplied generic *deeds* while the same construction at 2CH.32.23 (מִגְדָּנוֹת -> *precious things*) and everywhere else in the chapter is headed on the lexeme-bearing modifier. Rule 31's class-noun tie guidance requires that the ASV write the English noun alone for a Hebrew word of that same class in the verse, in the passage, or as its ordinary rendering of the word before it, and no bare *deeds* is written for חֶסֶד. Every edge is unchanged.
